title: Attendance
subtitle: Check-ins, check-outs, late arrivals and hours worked
dayOff: Today is a day off according to your schedule
noMark: No check-ins for this period — absences are entered by HR or the CEO.

errors.absenceDay: Vacation, sick leave or a day off is recorded for today
errors.notTracked: Only managers and the Sales head (ROP) check in and out
errors.notTrackedUser: Attendance is tracked only for managers and the Sales head (ROP)

checkout.remindBody: Your scheduled working day ended at {end}. Check out in the CRM — otherwise the day will be closed automatically and sent to the CEO for approval.
checkout.autoTitle: {name} did not check out on {date}. Counted until {end}. Approve the day
checkout.autoBody: If the employee really worked, press “Approve”. You can reject the day or correct the check-out time in the CRM.
checkout.autoOwnTitle: You did not check out on {date}. Counted until {end}
checkout.autoOwnBody: The day was closed automatically at the end of your schedule and awaits CEO approval. Until approved it does not count towards your salary.
checkout.rejectedTitle: Day {date} rejected — counted as an absence
checkout.banner: {count, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} without check-out awaiting approval
checkout.emptyText: Days when an employee did not check out and the day was closed automatically appear here.
checkout.hint: No check-out — the day was closed at the end of the schedule. “Approve” — the employee worked (the check-out time can be corrected), “Reject” — absence. Until decided, the day does not count towards the salary.
checkout.enabled: Remind about check-out and close the day automatically
checkout.reminderGraceHint: After the scheduled end of the working day — notification “You have not checked out”.
checkout.autoDelayHint: After the end of the schedule the check-out is set to the scheduled end and the day goes to the CEO for approval. On a day off or without a schedule — at 23:59.

errors.decided: This day has already been decided
errors.delayBeforeReminder: Auto check-out cannot be earlier than the reminder
